acceptance: Current opt-in client and immutable pre-negotiation wire fixture work against the actual new server. Unsupported offers return UPGRADE_REQUIRED after current cookie/CSRF/session checks; Origin/revoke checks preserved.

Legacy handshakes receive no extra event, strict old ACK/snapshot/delta/identity schemas remain unchanged, and absent-discovery404 current web fallback omits new input fields. Source-derived fixture and actual browser/TCP assertions verify their scope.

Application protocol1, scene schema1, canonical scene-description SHA256 and38-entry database journal are independent. Scene mismatch rejects before allocation; async digest pending logout cannot produce stale success/publication.

Current client owns a fresh manager per explicit entry, waits for current nonce selection, resets per-connection sequencing, and retains existing gap/epoch/revoke recovery. Transport retries do not imply exactly-once; durable receipts remain unchanged.

Delayed discovery preserves keyboard entry focus and rejects early activation; deterministic actual browser regression fails before fix and passes after. Existing focus/gameplay assertions and performance budgets are unchanged; two keyboard setups add explicit readiness waits only.
limitations: Local Node/disposable PostgreSQL and responsive Chromium emulation only; no physical Android/iOS evidence or previous deployed server/binary.
Pinned old source/wire fixtures establish the stated compatibility window; N12 still requires tested image digests and release/rollback qualification.
Scene identity covers the validated scene description; legacy joins require immutable semantic versions and gain no hash guarantee.
Current browser falls back only on absent discovery; an already loaded client during server rollback can require reload.
No protocol response grants authentication/permission or exactly-once delivery; snapshots/gap/epoch repair and receipts remain authoritative.
Hosted baseline cadence and repository enforcement limitations remain unresolved; no hosted runs, pushes, publish, production/store/operator/adult/media approval.
Private raw evidence remains local until owner cleanup, not off-host archived.

Fresh browser matrix is study and legacy only; city/social/hospitality/private groups are not newly executed by this task. Full pnpm check does not itself run Playwright. Browser timing is local emulation, not production capacity or GPU certification.
